description: This file defines the ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator class, which helps set up an individual stream provider on a silo in Orleans. It provides methods for configuring ADO.NET options, cache size, and partitioning for ADO.NET stream providers.

classes.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up ADO.NET stream provider options on an Orleans client.

methods.name: ClusterClientAdoNetStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with a name and client builder, setting up dependency injection and default partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Allows custom configuration of ADO.NET stream options.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures the cache size for the stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the stream provider.
